name: Jaa
source:
He is a master of Muay Thai.
He used to be an elephant handler in the interior of Thailand, but was chased by the police after accidentally killing an elephant poacher, and was picked up by Ramrowan. He can speak a little Cantonese, but for some reason he is polite in Cantonese. He is a serious person.
He gets involved in a case when he picks up John's dropped smartphone in Macau.
